text: Anndee wonnde Nulaaɗo Allah on hino hakkunde mon, onon muumini'en, wahayu on no jippaade e makko, rentoɗon e fennugol, sakko wahayu jippoo e makko humpitugol mo ngol fennugol mo, e hino le himo anndi ko moƴƴanta on. Si o tewtino on e ko holloton mo, on yanayno e tampere nde o faalananooka on. Kono Allah kan, e ɓural Makko ngal, O yiɗini on gomɗinal, O cuɗini ngal e ɓerɗe mon haa gomɗinɗon; O añini on keeferaaku, e yaltugol e ɗoftaare Makko, e yeddugol Mo. Ko ɓen siforaaɓe ɗin sifaaji ɗon, woni jokkuɓe laawol peewal ngol.
